Federico Molinari is a professional artistic gymnast from Argentina, known for his accomplishments on the international gymnastics stage. Born on January 11, 1984, in Rosario, Argentina, Molinari has represented his country in various international competitions, including the Olympic Games, World Championships, and Pan American Games.

One of Molinari's notable achievements was his participation in the 2012 London Olympics, where he became the first Argentine gymnast to qualify for an Olympic final. He competed in the rings event and finished in 8th place, a significant milestone for Argentine gymnastics.

Molinari has also been a strong competitor in the Pan American Games, earning medals and showcasing his talents over the years. His specialties are in the still rings, and he has become well-regarded for his strength and technique in this apparatus.

In addition to his athletic career, Federico Molinari is also involved in gymnastics coaching and has established a gymnastics academy to help develop the next generation of gymnasts. His dedication to the sport extends to promoting gymnastics in Argentina and inspiring young athletes.

Throughout his career, Molinari has been celebrated for his contributions to gymnastics in Argentina and remains a respected figure in the sport for his perseverance and achievements.
